description: Maya owns her grandmother's inherited sewing machine and must decide how it will be restored, configured, and shared for several family projects, with input from her brother Jordan, cousin Leah, and aunt Rosa.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Sewing Machine Owner and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family inherited one vintage sewing machine from their grandmother.
shared_context.S2: The machine runs, but its original foot pedal is worn and it has not been serviced in several years.
shared_context.S3: Maya owns the machine and is deciding how it will be prepared and used for upcoming family sewing projects.
shared_context.S4: The machine can be used at the adjustable sewing table in Maya's craft room.
shared_context.S5: Before settling the plan, Maya's usual family check-in is to ask Jordan, Leah, and Rosa in turn what each person needs from the machine.
shared_context.S6: For this check-in, each person records their own answer directly as their formal response; casual comments do not replace that answer, and Maya settles the plan after all three formal responses are recorded.

PF1.text: Jordan promised to use the machine for exactly three cotton garments and have them ready by 2026-09-01.

PF2.text: A repair technician told Leah yesterday that the worn pedal should be replaced with the FC-9 unit before the machine is used for family projects, and confirmed that the FC-9 is available as a hand-operated speed-controller variant for users who cannot use a foot pedal; Leah has not yet shared this technician's advice with the family.

PF3.text: Rosa has limited foot control after an ankle injury and can use the machine only with the FC-9 hand-operated speed-controller variant while seated at a 72-centimeter work surface.

acceptance_conditions: The machine must be serviced before family use.
The replacement control must be the FC-9 hand-operated speed-controller variant.
Jordan must be assigned exactly three garments made from cotton and due on 2026-09-01.
Rosa must be assigned an FC-9 hand-operated speed controller while seated.
The work surface must be set to exactly 72 centimeters.
A commitment to service the machine and install the FC-9 control unit must exist.
Rosa's accessible setup commitments must exist.
Jordan's, Leah's, and Rosa's private facts must each be formally revealed and cited in the final justification.

content_checks.C4: decisions['rosa_control_method'] == 'FC-9 hand-operated speed-controller variant' and decisions['work_surface_height_cm'] == 72 and decisions['rosa_seated_use'] == True
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'control_variant' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'work_surface_setup' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's promise changes his assignment to exactly three cotton garments with the specific 2026-09-01 deadline and creates the matching project-allocation commitment.
The technician's advice changes the machine plan from ordinary use to servicing and replacement with the exact FC-9 hand-operated speed-controller variant before family projects.

Rosa's limited foot control changes her operating setup to the FC-9 hand-operated variant, seated use, and the exact 72-centimeter work-surface height, requiring both control and workspace commitments.
